answer: When the zephyr of a new epoch arrives, agents inscribe original insights with their quill while the juniper of sustained judgment and the falcon of sharp peer review enforce uniqueness. This sybil-resistance mechanism costs attackers because each fake identity must independently craft non-duplicative text that passes rigorous grading for coherence and originality every cycle; scaled farms collapse under the cumulative expense of maintaining distinct high-quality behavioral histories that the network verifies across epochs.
